```yaml
name: Notify Dev Channel

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - 'src/**'

jobs:
  notify-dev-channel:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Extract PR number
        id: extract_pr_number
        run: |
          pr_number=$(echo $GITHUB_COMMIT_MESSAGE | grep -oP '(?<=Merge pull request #)\d+')
          echo "::set-output name=pr_number::$pr_number"

      - name: Find linked issues
        id: find_linked_issues
        run: |
          pr_body=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/pulls/${{ steps.extract_pr_number.outputs.pr_number }}/commits | jq -r '.[].commit.message')
          issues=$(echo "$pr_body" | grep -oP '(?<=Closes|Fixes|Resolves) #\d+' | tr '\n' ', ')
          echo "::set-output name=linked_issues::$issues"

      - name: Post comment to PR
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"body\": \"## 🧪 Your changes are now in the dev channel!\\n\\nYour PR has been merged to master and is available for testing in the **dev channel**.\\n\\n**Test your changes before the Tuesday release:**\\n📖 **[Dev Channel Documentation](https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/blob/master/docs/dev-channel.md)**\\n\\nQuick start: \\`uvx ha-mcp-dev\\``}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/issues/${{ steps.extract_pr_number.outputs.pr_number }}/comments

      - name: Post comment to linked issues
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          IFS=',' read -ra issues <<< "${{ steps.find_linked_issues.outputs.linked_issues }}"
          for issue in "${issues[@]}"; do
            issue_number=${issue#* }
            curl -X POST \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"body\": \"## ✅ This issue has been addressed in the dev channel!\\nA fix for this issue has been merged to master (PR #${{ steps.extract_pr_number.outputs.pr_number }}) and is available for testing...\"}" \
              https://api.github.com/repos/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/issues/$issue_number/comments
          done
```
